title.zh: 有限责任合伙（相同名称）条例 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Limited Liability Partnerships (Identical Names) Regulations 2015 and come into operation on 3 January 2016.
3. The Limited Liability Partnerships (Identical Names) Rules (R 1) are revoked.
